sentences.text: Adzhosuchus is an extinct genus of crocodyliform belonging to the family Shartegosuchidae.
Fossils of this animal were discovered in southwestern Mongolia and the genus was described by Efimov and colleagues in 2000.
Adzhosuchus lived during the Late Jurassic period, specifically between 149.2 and 143.1 million years ago during the Tithonian stage.
